title: The Book of Daniel Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Daniel — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
verses.decoded: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem and surrounded the city.

verses.kjv: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
verses.decoded: The Lord allowed Nebuchadnezzar to capture Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and he took some of the sacred items from the temple and brought them to Babylon, to the temple of his god, placing them in the treasury there.

verses.kjv: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;
verses.decoded: The king told Ashpenaz, his chief eunuch, to bring some young men from Israel, including members of the royal family and nobles.

verses.kjv: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: These young men had to be without defects, attractive, intelligent, knowledgeable, quick to learn, capable of serving in the king's palace, and able to be taught the language and customs of the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
verses.decoded: The king provided them daily with his own food and wine for three years to prepare them to serve in his presence.

verses.kjv: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.decoded: Among these young men from Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

verses.kjv: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
verses.decoded: The chief eunuch gave them new Babylonian names: Daniel was called Belteshazzar, Hananiah was Shadrach, Mishael was Meshach, and Azariah was Abednego.

verses.kjv: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.decoded: But Daniel decided not to make himself unclean by eating the king’s food or drinking his wine, so he asked the chief eunuch for permission to avoid them.

verses.kjv: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.decoded: God caused the chief eunuch to like Daniel and show him kindness.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
verses.decoded: The chief eunuch said to Daniel, 'I’m afraid of the king, who decided what you should eat and drink. If you look worse than the other young men your age, the king will be angry and I could lose my life.'

verses.kjv: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.decoded: Daniel spoke to Melzar, the official appointed by the chief eunuch to supervise Daniel and his three friends,

verses.kjv: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
verses.decoded: and said, 'Please test us for ten days by giving us only vegetables to eat and water to drink.'

verses.kjv: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
verses.decoded: After ten days, compare our appearance with that of the young men who eat the king’s food, and treat us according to what you see.

verses.kjv: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
verses.decoded: The steward agreed to the test and tried it for ten days.

verses.kjv: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.
verses.decoded: After ten days, they looked healthier and better nourished than all the young men who ate the king’s food.

verses.kjv: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
verses.decoded: So Melzar took away their regular food and wine and gave them only vegetables to eat.

verses.kjv: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.decoded: God gave these four young men knowledge, skill in learning, and wisdom; and Daniel was able to understand all visions and dreams.

verses.kjv: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.decoded: At the end of the training period the king had set, the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
verses.decoded: The king spoke with them and found that none were like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, so they stayed in his presence.

verses.kjv: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
verses.decoded: In every question of wisdom and understanding the king asked about, they were found to be ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers in his entire kingdom.

verses.kjv: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
verses.decoded: Daniel remained in service until the first year of King Cyrus.

verses.kjv: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
verses.decoded: In the second year of King Nebuchadnezzar's rule, he had troubling dreams that disturbed his spirit and caused him to lose sleep.

verses.kjv: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.decoded: The king ordered his magicians, astrologers, sorcerers, and Chaldeans to come and tell him his dreams. They came and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
verses.decoded: The king said to them, 'I had a dream, and I am deeply troubled because I want to understand it.'

verses.kjv: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
verses.decoded: The Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic, 'Long live the king! Tell your servants the dream, and we will interpret it for you.'

verses.kjv: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.decoded: The king replied, 'I have forgotten the dream. If you do not tell me the dream and its meaning, you will be torn apart and your homes destroyed.'

verses.kjv: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.decoded: But if you tell me the dream and its meaning, I will give you gifts, rewards, and great honor. So tell me the dream and its interpretation.

verses.kjv: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
verses.decoded: They answered again, 'Let the king tell us the dream, and we will explain what it means.'

verses.kjv: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
verses.decoded: The king said, 'I know you are trying to buy time because you realize I have forgotten the dream.'

verses.kjv: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
verses.decoded: If you don’t tell me the dream, there is only one punishment for you, because you have planned to lie and deceive me to buy time. So tell me the dream, and then I will know you can interpret it.

verses.kjv: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.decoded: The Chaldeans replied, 'No one on earth can tell the king what he wants. No king or ruler has ever asked such a thing of any magician, astrologer, or Chaldean.'

verses.kjv: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.decoded: The king is asking for something very unusual, and no one can reveal it except the gods, who do not live in human bodies.

verses.kjv: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the king became very angry and ordered all the wise men of Babylon to be killed.

verses.kjv: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
verses.decoded: The order was issued to kill the wise men, and they were looking for Daniel and his friends to kill them as well.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:
verses.decoded: Daniel wisely and thoughtfully spoke to Arioch, the king’s captain of the guard, who had been sent to kill the wise men of Babylon.

verses.kjv: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.decoded: Daniel asked Arioch, 'Why is the king’s order so urgent?' Then Arioch explained the situation to Daniel.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
verses.decoded: Daniel went to the king and asked for some time so he could explain the dream's meaning.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
verses.decoded: Daniel went home and told his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah about the situation.

verses.kjv: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.decoded: They prayed to God in heaven to show mercy and reveal the secret so that Daniel and his friends wouldn’t be killed like the other wise men.

verses.kjv: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.decoded: That night, God revealed the secret to Daniel in a vision, and Daniel praised God.

verses.kjv: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
verses.decoded: Daniel said, "Praise God forever, for He has wisdom and power."

verses.kjv: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verses.decoded: God controls the times and seasons; He removes kings and sets up kings; He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who understand.

verses.kjv: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
verses.decoded: He reveals hidden and secret things; He knows what’s in the darkness, and light lives with Him.

verses.kjv: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king’s matter.
verses.decoded: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors, for giving me wisdom and power and revealing to me what we asked for—the king’s secret.

verses.kjv: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
verses.decoded: Daniel went to Arioch, the king’s officer assigned to kill the wise men, and said, "Don’t kill the wise men. Take me to the king, and I will explain the dream."

verses.kjv: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
verses.decoded: Arioch quickly brought Daniel before the king and said, "I found a man from the Jewish captives who can explain the king’s dream."

verses.kjv: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
verses.decoded: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), "Can you tell me the dream I had and what it means?"

verses.kjv: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
verses.decoded: Daniel replied, "No wise men, astrologers, magicians, or fortune-tellers can explain this secret to the king."

verses.kjv: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
verses.decoded: But there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets and has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the future. This is the dream and vision you had while lying in bed.

verses.kjv: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.
verses.decoded: King, you thought about the future while in bed, and God who reveals secrets has made it known to you.

verses.kjv: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
verses.decoded: As for me, I don’t have special wisdom beyond others. This secret was revealed so I could explain it to the king and help him understand what he is thinking.

verses.kjv: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.
verses.decoded: You, O king, saw a large statue. This statue was very bright and impressive, standing right in front of you; its appearance was frightening.

verses.kjv: This image’s head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
verses.decoded: The statue's head was made of pure gold, its chest and arms were silver, and its stomach and thighs were bronze.

verses.kjv: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
verses.decoded: Its legs were iron, but its feet were made partly of iron and partly of clay.

verses.kjv: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
verses.decoded: You saw until a stone, not cut by human hands, struck the statue’s feet made of iron and clay, breaking them into pieces.

verses.kjv: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
verses.decoded: Then the iron, clay, bronze, silver, and gold were all smashed together and became like worthless chaff blown away by the wind, leaving no trace. The stone that hit the statue grew into a huge mountain that filled the entire earth.

verses.kjv: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
verses.decoded: This is the dream, and now we will explain its meaning to the king.

verses.kjv: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
verses.decoded: You, O king, are a ruler above all rulers because the God of heaven has given you your kingdom, power, strength, and glory.

verses.kjv: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.
verses.decoded: Wherever people live, God has put animals and birds under your control and made you ruler over everything. You are the head of gold in the statue.

verses.kjv: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
verses.decoded: After you, another kingdom will rise that is less powerful, then a third kingdom made of bronze that will rule the whole earth.

verses.kjv: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
verses.decoded: The fourth kingdom will be as strong as iron, because iron crushes and breaks everything. It will smash and crush all the others.

verses.kjv: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
verses.decoded: You saw that the feet and toes were partly made of clay and partly iron. This means the kingdom will be divided, but it will still have some strength like iron, even though iron is mixed with soft clay.

verses.kjv: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
verses.decoded: Just as the toes were partly iron and partly clay, the kingdom will be partly strong and partly fragile.

verses.kjv: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
verses.decoded: Because iron was mixed with soft clay, people will try to unite but won’t truly stick together, just like iron doesn’t blend with clay.

verses.kjv: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
verses.decoded: During the time of these kingdoms, God will establish a kingdom that will never be destroyed or passed to others. It will destroy all these kingdoms and last forever.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
verses.decoded: Because you saw the stone cut from a mountain without human hands smash the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold, the great God has revealed to the king what will happen in the future. The dream is true and its meaning is certain.

verses.kjv: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed down before Daniel and worshiped him. He then ordered that sacrifices and fragrant offerings be made to Daniel.

verses.kjv: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
verses.decoded: The king said to Daniel, 'Truly, your God is the God above all gods and the Lord over all kings. He reveals mysteries because you were able to explain this secret dream.'

verses.kjv: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.decoded: The king promoted Daniel to a high position, gave him many valuable gifts, made him governor over the entire province of Babylon, and placed him in charge of all the wise men in Babylon.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
verses.decoded: Daniel asked the king to appoint Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to manage the province of Babylon, while Daniel himself remained at the king’s gate.

verses.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar made a gold statue that was 60 cubits tall and 6 cubits wide. He placed it in the plain of Dura, in Babylon.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to gather the princes, governors, captains, judges, treasurers, counselors, sheriffs, and all provincial leaders to attend the dedication of the statue he had set up.

verses.kjv: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.decoded: So all the princes, governors, captains, judges, treasurers, counselors, sheriffs, and rulers gathered for the statue’s dedication and stood before it.

verses.kjv: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,
verses.decoded: A herald loudly announced, 'It is commanded to all people, nations, and languages:'

verses.kjv: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:
verses.decoded: Whenever you hear the sound of the trumpet, flute, harp, lyre, harp, dulcimer, or any kind of music, you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

verses.kjv: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace.

verses.kjv: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.decoded: So when everyone heard the music, all the people from every nation and language fell down and worshipped the golden statue set up by King Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.
verses.decoded: At that time, some Chaldeans came forward and accused the Jewish men.

verses.kjv: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
verses.decoded: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, 'Long live the king!'

verses.kjv: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
verses.decoded: You, O king, have commanded that everyone who hears the sound of the trumpet, flute, harp, lyre, harp, dulcimer, or any music must fall down and worship the golden statue.

verses.kjv: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does not fall down and worship will be thrown immediately into the fiery furnace.

verses.kjv: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
verses.decoded: There are some Jews you have appointed to manage Babylon’s affairs—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—but these men, O king, do not respect you. They do not serve your gods or worship the golden statue you set up.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar, furious and angry, ordered Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to be brought before him. So they brought the men to the king.

verses.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar said to them, 'Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the golden statue I have set up?'

verses.kjv: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?
verses.decoded: Now, if you are ready to fall down and worship the statue whenever you hear the music, well and good. But if you do not worship, you will be thrown immediately into the fiery furnace. And who is the god that can save you from my power?'

verses.kjv: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
verses.decoded: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego replied to King Nebuchadnezzar, 'We do not need to defend ourselves in this matter.'

verses.kjv: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
verses.decoded: If it is God's will, the God we serve can save us from the fiery furnace and rescue us from your power, O king.

verses.kjv: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
verses.decoded: But even if He does not save us, know this, O king: we will never serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.

verses.kjv: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar was furious, and his face showed his anger toward Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.

verses.kjv: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.decoded: He commanded the strongest soldiers in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego and throw them into the blazing furnace.

verses.kjv: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.decoded: The men were tied up in their robes, trousers, turbans, and other clothes and thrown into the middle of the fiery furnace.

verses.kjv: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.
verses.decoded: Because the king's order was urgent and the furnace extremely hot, the flames killed the soldiers who threw Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego into the fire.

verses.kjv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.decoded: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego fell, tied up, into the middle of the blazing furnace.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar was amazed. He quickly stood up and asked his advisors, 'Didn't we throw three men tied up into the fire?' They replied, 'Yes, Your Majesty.'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Look! I see four men walking freely in the fire, unharmed. The fourth looks like a divine being.'

verses.kjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar approached the opening of the furnace and called, 'Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out!' They came out of the fire.

verses.kjv: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
verses.decoded: The officials and advisors gathered and saw that the men were completely unharmed by the fire; not a hair on their heads was singed, their clothes were untouched, and there was no smell of smoke on them.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar said, 'Praise be to the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who sent His angel to save His servants who trusted Him. They defied my order and risked their lives rather than worship any god except their own.'

verses.kjv: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.
verses.decoded: So I decree that anyone who speaks against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego will be torn apart, and their homes will be destroyed, because no other god can save like this.

verses.kjv: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
verses.decoded: The king then gave Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego higher positions of authority in the province of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.decoded: King Nebuchadnezzar sends greetings of peace to everyone living all over the world, no matter their nation or language.

verses.kjv: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.
verses.decoded: I decided it was right to share the amazing signs and miracles that the Most High God has done for me.

verses.kjv: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.decoded: His signs are incredible, and his miracles are powerful! His kingdom lasts forever, and his rule continues through all generations.

verses.kjv: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:
verses.decoded: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was living comfortably in my home and prospering in my palace.

verses.kjv: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.decoded: I had a dream that frightened me, and the thoughts and images from it disturbed me even while I was in bed.

verses.kjv: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.decoded: So I ordered all the wise men of Babylon to come to me so they could explain the meaning of my dream.

verses.kjv: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
verses.decoded: The magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and fortune-tellers came, and I told them my dream, but none could explain what it meant.

verses.kjv: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my God, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,
verses.decoded: Finally, Daniel, also called Belteshazzar after my god, came before me. He has the spirit of the holy gods. I told him the dream.

verses.kjv: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.decoded: Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know you have the spirit of the holy gods and that no mystery is too difficult for you. Please tell me the meaning of my dream and its vision.

verses.kjv: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.
verses.decoded: This is what I saw in my dream while lying in bed: a huge tree stood in the middle of the earth, and it was very tall.

verses.kjv: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
verses.decoded: The tree grew strong and tall, reaching up to heaven, and it could be seen from everywhere on earth.

verses.kjv: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
verses.decoded: Its leaves were beautiful, it produced a lot of fruit, and it provided food for everyone. Animals rested in its shade, birds lived in its branches, and all creatures were nourished by it.

verses.kjv: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
verses.decoded: In my dream, I saw a holy angelic being come down from heaven.

verses.kjv: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
verses.decoded: He shouted loudly, 'Cut down the tree, trim off its branches, strip off its leaves, and scatter its fruit. Let the animals leave its shade and the birds fly away from its branches.'

verses.kjv: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:
verses.decoded: But leave the stump and roots in the ground, bound with iron and bronze, surrounded by soft grass. Let it be watered by the dew from heaven, and let it share its place with the animals in the field.

verses.kjv: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.
verses.decoded: Change his mind from that of a human and give him the mind of an animal; let this last for seven periods of time.

verses.kjv: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.
verses.decoded: This decision comes from the heavenly beings, the watchers and holy ones, so that everyone alive will understand that the Most High God rules over human kingdoms and gives power to anyone he chooses, even the lowest people.

verses.kjv: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.
verses.decoded: I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have had this dream. Belteshazzar, explain what it means because none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it, but you can because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.
verses.decoded: Daniel (Belteshazzar) was shocked and worried for about an hour. The king told him not to be upset by the dream or its meaning. Daniel replied, ‘My lord, this dream is bad news for those who hate you and the interpretation is for your enemies.’

verses.kjv: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
verses.decoded: The tree you saw grew tall and strong, reaching up to the sky, and everyone on earth could see it.

verses.kjv: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:
verses.decoded: Its leaves were beautiful and it produced a lot of fruit that fed many; wild animals lived under it and birds made their homes in its branches.

verses.kjv: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.decoded: You, O king, are that tree. You have grown powerful; your greatness reaches to the heavens and your rule extends to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;
verses.decoded: The king saw a heavenly being come down and order the tree to be cut down and destroyed, but to leave the roots in the ground, bound with iron and bronze, among the grass. The tree would be watered by the dew and live with the wild animals until seven periods of time passed.

verses.kjv: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:
verses.decoded: This is the meaning, O king, and this is the command from the Most High that has come upon you, my lord the king:

verses.kjv: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
verses.decoded: You will be forced to live apart from people and live like wild animals, eating grass like cows and being wet with the dew of heaven. This will last for seven periods of time until you realize that the Most High God rules over human kingdoms and gives power to anyone he chooses.

verses.kjv: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
verses.decoded: Because they ordered the roots of the tree to be left intact, your kingdom will be restored to you once you recognize that heaven rules.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
verses.decoded: So, O king, accept my advice: stop your sins by doing what is right, and remove your wrongdoings by being kind to the poor. This may help you enjoy longer peace and healing.

verses.kjv: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.decoded: All these things happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
verses.decoded: After twelve months, he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.

verses.kjv: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
verses.decoded: The king said, ‘Is this not the great Babylon that I built as the center of my kingdom by my own power and for the glory of my majesty?’

verses.kjv: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.
verses.decoded: While the king was still speaking, a voice from heaven said, 'King Nebuchadnezzar, this message is for you: Your kingdom has been taken away from you.'

verses.kjv: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
verses.decoded: You will be forced to live away from people, and you will live like an animal, eating grass like cattle. This will last for seven periods of time, until you realize that the Most High rules over all kingdoms and gives power to anyone he chooses.

verses.kjv: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.
verses.decoded: At that very moment, what was predicted happened to Nebuchadnezzar: he was forced away from people and ate grass like an ox. His body was covered with dew from heaven, and his hair grew long and wild like eagle feathers, and his nails like bird claws.

verses.kjv: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:
verses.decoded: After the time had passed, I, Nebuchadnezzar, looked up to heaven, my sanity returned, and I praised and honored the Most High God, who lives forever. His kingdom lasts forever and is passed down through all generations.

verses.kjv: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.decoded: Everyone on earth is considered nothing compared to Him. He does whatever He wants in heaven’s armies and on earth’s inhabitants. No one can stop Him or ask, 'What are you doing?'

verses.kjv: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
verses.decoded: At that moment, my sanity came back. My honor and splendor as king returned. My advisors and nobles came back to me, and I was restored to my throne with even greater majesty.

verses.kjv: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.
verses.decoded: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise, honor, and glorify the King of heaven. All His actions are true and just, and He can humble those who are proud.

verses.kjv: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
verses.decoded: King Belshazzar held a large banquet for a thousand of his nobles and drank wine in front of them all.

verses.kjv: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.
verses.decoded: While drinking wine, Belshazzar ordered that the gold and silver cups, which his ancestor Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem, be brought so that he, his nobles, wives, and concubines could drink from them.

verses.kjv: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.
verses.decoded: They brought the gold cups taken from the temple in Jerusalem, and the king, his nobles, wives, and concubines drank from them.

verses.kjv: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
verses.decoded: They drank wine and praised gods made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

verses.kjv: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
verses.decoded: At that moment, a human hand appeared and wrote mysterious words on the plaster wall opposite the lampstand in the king’s palace. The king saw the hand writing.

verses.kjv: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
verses.decoded: The king’s face changed, and he became very frightened and confused, so much that his body shook and his knees knocked together.

verses.kjv: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.decoded: The king shouted for the astrologers, Chaldeans, and fortune-tellers to come. He told the wise men of Babylon that whoever could read and explain the writing would be dressed in scarlet, given a gold chain, and become the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

verses.kjv: Then came in all the king’s wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.
verses.decoded: All the king’s wise men came, but none could read the writing or explain its meaning to the king.

verses.kjv: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.
verses.decoded: King Belshazzar became very upset; his face showed fear, and his nobles were shocked.

verses.kjv: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:
verses.decoded: Hearing the king and nobles, the queen entered the banquet hall and said, “Long live the king! Don’t let your thoughts upset you or your face show fear.”

verses.kjv: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;
verses.decoded: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods. In your father’s time, he was known for his insight, understanding, and wisdom like that of the gods. King Nebuchadnezzar, your ancestor, made him chief of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and fortune-tellers.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.
verses.decoded: Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar, has an excellent spirit, knowledge, and understanding. He can interpret dreams, explain difficult problems, and solve mysteries. Call Daniel, and he will explain the writing.

verses.kjv: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Art thou that Daniel, which art of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?
verses.decoded: Daniel was brought before the king. The king said, “Are you Daniel, one of the exiles from Judah whom my father brought from Jerusalem?”

verses.kjv: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.
verses.decoded: I have heard that you have the spirit of the gods, and that you possess insight, understanding, and exceptional wisdom.

verses.kjv: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:
verses.decoded: The wise men and astrologers were brought before me to read and explain this writing, but they could not interpret it.

verses.kjv: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.decoded: I have heard that you can interpret dreams and solve difficult problems. If you can read this writing and explain what it means, you will be dressed in scarlet, given a gold chain to wear around your neck, and become the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

verses.kjv: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
verses.decoded: Daniel replied to the king, 'Keep your gifts and rewards for yourself. I will read the writing and explain its meaning to you anyway.'

verses.kjv: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:
verses.decoded: O king, the Most High God gave your ancestor Nebuchadnezzar a kingdom, greatness, glory, and honor.

verses.kjv: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.
verses.decoded: Because of the greatness God gave him, all peoples, nations, and languages feared and respected him. He killed whom he wanted, kept others alive, and raised some up while putting others down.

verses.kjv: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:
verses.decoded: But when he became proud and stubborn, he was removed from his throne and lost his honor.

verses.kjv: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.
verses.decoded: He was forced to live away from people, his mind became like that of an animal, and he lived with wild donkeys. They fed him grass like cattle, and his body was covered with dew until he realized that the Most High God rules over all kingdoms and appoints rulers as He wishes.

verses.kjv: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
verses.decoded: But you, Belshazzar, his son, have not humbled yourself even though you knew all this.

verses.kjv: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:
verses.decoded: Instead, you have defied the Lord of heaven. You brought the sacred vessels from His temple and, along with your nobles, wives, and concubines, drank wine from them. You praised gods made of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone—gods that cannot see, hear, or understand. But you have not honored the God who holds your life and controls all your ways.

verses.kjv: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
verses.decoded: Then a hand appeared and wrote this message.

verses.kjv: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
verses.decoded: This is the writing that was written: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

verses.kjv: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.
verses.decoded: Here is what it means: MENE—God has counted the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end.

verses.kjv: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
verses.decoded: TEKEL—You have been weighed on the scales and found deficient.

verses.kjv: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
verses.decoded: PERES—Your kingdom will be divided and given to the Medes and Persians.

verses.kjv: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.decoded: Then Belshazzar ordered that Daniel be dressed in scarlet, given a gold chain around his neck, and declared the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

verses.kjv: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.
verses.decoded: That very night, Belshazzar, king of the Chaldeans, was killed.

verses.kjv: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
verses.decoded: Darius the Mede took over the kingdom when he was about 62 years old.

verses.kjv: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;
verses.decoded: King Darius decided to appoint 120 officials to oversee the entire kingdom;

verses.kjv: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.
verses.decoded: and above them, three top officials, with Daniel as the chief, so that the officials would report to them and the king would not suffer any loss.

verses.kjv: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
verses.decoded: Daniel was given higher status than the other officials because he had an exceptional spirit; the king planned to put him in charge of the entire kingdom.

verses.kjv: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
verses.decoded: The other officials tried to find a reason to accuse Daniel regarding his duties, but they found no fault because he was trustworthy and without error.

verses.kjv: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his God.
verses.decoded: They said, 'We can't accuse Daniel unless we catch him breaking the law of his God.'

verses.kjv: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
verses.decoded: These officials gathered before the king and said, 'Long live King Darius!'

verses.kjv: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
verses.decoded: All the top officials have agreed to create a law that anyone who prays to any god or person except the king for thirty days will be thrown into the lions’ den.

verses.kjv: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
verses.decoded: King, please approve and sign this law so it cannot be changed, because the laws of the Medes and Persians cannot be altered.

verses.kjv: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
verses.decoded: So King Darius signed the law and made it official.

verses.kjv: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
verses.decoded: When Daniel learned the law was signed, he went home, opened his windows facing Jerusalem, and prayed three times a day as usual, giving thanks to God.

verses.kjv: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
verses.decoded: The officials gathered and caught Daniel praying to his God.

verses.kjv: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
verses.decoded: They confronted the king, saying, 'Didn’t you sign a law that anyone who prays to any god or person except you for thirty days must be thrown to the lions?' The king replied, 'Yes, that’s true; the law of the Medes and Persians cannot be changed.'

verses.kjv: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.
verses.decoded: They said to the king, 'Daniel, a Jew from the exile, does not obey you or the law you signed; he prays three times a day.'

verses.kjv: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
verses.decoded: The king was very upset with himself and wanted to save Daniel; he worked hard all day trying to find a way to rescue him.

verses.kjv: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.
verses.decoded: The officials told the king, 'Remember, no law of the Medes and Persians can be changed once it is made.'

verses.kjv: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
verses.decoded: The king ordered Daniel to be brought and thrown into the lions' den. Then the king said to Daniel, 'Your God, whom you serve faithfully, will protect you.'

verses.kjv: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
verses.decoded: A stone was placed over the entrance of the den, and the king sealed it with his own ring and the rings of his officials to ensure that no one could change the order about Daniel.

verses.kjv: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.
verses.decoded: The king returned to his palace and spent the night without eating. No music was played for him, and he could not sleep.

verses.kjv: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
verses.decoded: Early the next morning, the king hurried to the lions' den.

verses.kjv: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?
verses.decoded: When he reached the den, the king called out to Daniel in a distressed voice, 'Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve faithfully, been able to save you from the lions?'

verses.kjv: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.
verses.decoded: Daniel replied, 'May the king live forever!'

verses.kjv: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
verses.decoded: My God sent his angel to close the lions' mouths so they would not harm me, because I was found innocent in His sight and have done no wrong to you, O king.

verses.kjv: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
verses.decoded: The king was extremely happy and ordered Daniel to be lifted out of the den. Daniel was unharmed because he trusted in his God.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.
verses.decoded: The king ordered the men who accused Daniel, along with their children and wives, to be thrown into the lions' den. The lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones before they reached the bottom.

verses.kjv: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.decoded: King Darius sent a message to all peoples, nations, and languages across the earth: 'May you have great peace.'

verses.kjv: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.
verses.decoded: I declare that in every part of my kingdom, people must respect and fear the God of Daniel, because He is the living God, eternal and unchanging. His kingdom will never be destroyed, and His rule will last forever.

verses.kjv: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
verses.decoded: He rescues and saves, performing miracles in heaven and on earth. He has saved Daniel from the lions' power.

verses.kjv: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.decoded: Daniel continued to succeed during the reigns of King Darius and King Cyrus the Persian.

verses.kjv: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.
verses.decoded: In the first year that Belshazzar was king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions while lying in bed. Then he wrote down the dream and explained its meaning.

verses.kjv: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.
verses.decoded: Daniel said, I saw in a night vision that the four winds of heaven were stirring up the great sea.

verses.kjv: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
verses.decoded: Four large beasts came up out of the sea, each different from the others.

verses.kjv: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
verses.decoded: The first beast looked like a lion with eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were torn off, and it was raised up to stand on two feet like a man, and it was given a human mind.

verses.kjv: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.
verses.decoded: Then another beast appeared, like a bear, raised up on one side. It had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth, and it was told, 'Get up and eat a lot of flesh.'

verses.kjv: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
verses.decoded: Next I saw a beast like a leopard with four wings on its back and four heads. It was given authority to rule.

verses.kjv: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
verses.decoded: Then I saw a fourth beast, very frightening, powerful, and strong. It had large iron teeth; it crushed and destroyed everything and trampled what was left. This beast was different from the others and had ten horns.

verses.kjv: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.decoded: I looked at the horns, and another small horn appeared among them. Three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like a human and a mouth that spoke arrogantly.

verses.kjv: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
verses.decoded: I watched as thrones were set up, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was white as snow, his hair like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames with wheels of burning fire.

verses.kjv: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.
verses.decoded: Flames flowed out from before him. Thousands upon thousands served him, and millions stood before him. A judgment was announced, and the books were opened.

verses.kjv: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.
verses.decoded: I watched because of the boastful words the horn spoke. I saw the beast being killed, its body destroyed and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.
verses.decoded: The other beasts lost their power, but their lives were extended for a while.

verses.kjv: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
verses.decoded: In my night vision, I saw someone like a Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was brought close to him.

verses.kjv: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
verses.decoded: He was given authority, glory, and a kingdom so that all people, nations, and languages would serve him. His kingdom is eternal and will never be destroyed.

verses.kjv: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.decoded: I, Daniel, was deeply troubled in my spirit and disturbed by the visions I saw.

verses.kjv: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
verses.decoded: I approached one of the beings standing nearby and asked him to explain the meaning of all this. He then explained it to me and helped me understand the interpretation.

verses.kjv: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.
verses.decoded: The four large beasts represent four kings who will come from the earth.

verses.kjv: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: But the holy people of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will rule forever and ever.

verses.kjv: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;
verses.decoded: Then I wanted to understand the meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others and very terrifying. It had iron teeth and bronze claws; it crushed and destroyed everything and trampled what was left underfoot.

verses.kjv: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.
verses.decoded: I also looked at the ten horns on its head and at another horn that appeared later, before which three horns fell. This horn had eyes and a mouth that spoke arrogantly, and it was more powerful than the others.

verses.kjv: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;
verses.decoded: I watched as that horn fought against the holy people and defeated them.

verses.kjv: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
verses.decoded: But then the Ancient of Days appeared, and the holy people were given judgment and authority. The time came when they took possession of the kingdom.

verses.kjv: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
verses.decoded: He said, 'The fourth beast represents the fourth kingdom on earth. It will be different from all the others and will consume the whole earth, crushing and destroying everything.'

verses.kjv: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.
verses.decoded: The ten horns represent ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them, another king will appear who will be different and will defeat three of the earlier kings.

verses.kjv: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
verses.decoded: This king will speak arrogantly against the Most High, oppress the holy people, and try to change laws and times. The holy people will be under his control for a set period.

verses.kjv: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.
verses.decoded: But judgment will be passed, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
verses.decoded: The kingdom, power, and greatness of all the earth will be given to God's holy people. Their kingdom will last forever, and all rulers will serve and obey them.

verses.kjv: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
verses.decoded: This is the end of the explanation. As for me, Daniel, I was deeply troubled by these visions, and my face showed my distress, but I kept the matter to myself.

verses.kjv: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
verses.decoded: In the third year of King Belshazzar's rule, I, Daniel, had another vision, following the one I had before.

verses.kjv: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
verses.decoded: In the vision, I found myself in the palace at Shushan, in the province of Elam, standing beside the Ulai River.

verses.kjv: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.decoded: I looked up and saw a ram standing by the river with two horns; one horn was taller than the other, and the taller one grew after the shorter.

verses.kjv: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
verses.decoded: The ram charged toward the west, north, and south, overpowering everything in its path; no one could stop or rescue anyone from it, and it became very powerful.

verses.kjv: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
verses.decoded: While I was thinking about this, a male goat appeared, coming from the west, moving so swiftly it seemed not to touch the ground. It had a prominent horn between its eyes.

verses.kjv: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
verses.decoded: The goat charged at the ram with great anger and strength.

verses.kjv: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.decoded: The goat attacked the ram, broke its two horns, and defeated it completely. The ram had no strength to resist and was trampled with no one able to save it.

verses.kjv: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.decoded: The goat became very powerful, but then its large horn was broken off, and in its place, four prominent horns grew, pointing toward the four directions of the earth.

verses.kjv: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
verses.decoded: From one of these four horns, a small horn grew and became extremely powerful, extending its influence toward the south, east, and the beautiful land (often understood as Israel).

verses.kjv: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
