verses.decoded: This horn grew so powerful that it challenged the heavenly forces, knocking some of them down and trampling on them.

verses.kjv: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.decoded: It exalted itself against the commander of the heavenly army, stopping the daily sacrifices and causing the holy place to be desecrated.

verses.kjv: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
verses.decoded: Because of rebellion, this power was allowed to oppose the daily sacrifices, overthrowing the truth and succeeding in its plans.

verses.kjv: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
verses.decoded: Then I heard one holy one speaking, and another asked him who was speaking, 'How long will this vision last—the daily sacrifices, the rebellion causing desolation, and the trampling of the sanctuary and the people?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
verses.decoded: The answer was, 'It will last for 2,300 days, then the sanctuary will be restored and made right again.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
verses.decoded: After I, Daniel, saw the vision and tried to understand it, suddenly a figure that looked like a man stood before me.

verses.kjv: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
verses.decoded: I heard a man's voice calling from between the banks of the Ulai River, saying, 'Gabriel, explain this vision to this man.'

verses.kjv: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
verses.decoded: Gabriel came close to where I was standing. When he arrived, I was afraid and fell face down, but he said to me, 'Understand, son of man, that this vision is about the time of the end.'

verses.kjv: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.decoded: While Gabriel was speaking, I was deeply asleep, face down on the ground. But he touched me and helped me stand up.

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Look, I will tell you what will happen at the very end of the anger. At the appointed time, the end will come.'

verses.kjv: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.decoded: The ram you saw with two horns represents the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.kjv: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.decoded: The rough goat represents the king of Greece, and the large horn between its eyes is the first king.

verses.kjv: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
verses.decoded: When the large horn is broken, four kingdoms will rise from that nation, but they will not have the same power.

verses.kjv: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
verses.decoded: Near the end of their rule, when wrongdoing is complete, a fierce king who understands secret meanings will rise.

verses.kjv: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
verses.decoded: His power will be great, but not by his own strength. He will cause great destruction, succeed in his plans, and destroy the strong and the holy people.

verses.kjv: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
verses.decoded: By his cunning, he will succeed and become proud. He will destroy many through false peace and oppose the Prince of princes, but he will be destroyed without human intervention.

verses.kjv: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
verses.decoded: The vision about the evening and morning is true. So keep the vision secret, because it refers to many days in the future.

verses.kjv: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
verses.decoded: I, Daniel, fainted and was sick for several days. Later, I got up and continued serving the king. I was amazed by the vision, but no one understood it.

verses.kjv: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
verses.decoded: In the first year that Darius, son of Ahasuerus, a descendant of the Medes, became king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans,

verses.kjv: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: In that first year of his reign, I, Daniel, studied the Scriptures and understood from the word of the LORD given to Jeremiah the prophet that Jerusalem would be desolate for seventy years.

verses.kjv: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
verses.decoded: So I turned my attention to the Lord God, praying and pleading with fasting, wearing sackcloth and ashes as signs of mourning and repentance.

verses.kjv: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
verses.decoded: I prayed to the LORD my God and confessed, saying, ‘O Lord, you are great and awesome, who keeps your covenant and shows mercy to those who love you and obey your commands.’

verses.kjv: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:
verses.decoded: We have sinned, done wrong, acted wickedly, and rebelled by turning away from your laws and judgments.

verses.kjv: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
verses.decoded: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, leaders, ancestors, and all the people of the land.

verses.kjv: O LORD, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.
verses.decoded: O Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but we face shame and disgrace today—this is true for the people of Judah, Jerusalem, and all Israel, both near and far, wherever you have scattered them because of their sins against you.

verses.kjv: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.
verses.decoded: O Lord, we and our kings, leaders, and ancestors are covered with shame because we have sinned against you.

verses.kjv: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
verses.decoded: But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him.

verses.kjv: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
verses.decoded: We have not obeyed the LORD our God or followed the laws he gave us through his servants the prophets.

verses.kjv: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
verses.decoded: All Israel has broken your law by turning away and refusing to obey you. Because of this, the curses and promises written in the law of Moses, your servant, have come upon us since we have sinned against you.

verses.kjv: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: God has fulfilled the warnings he gave us and our leaders by bringing great disaster upon us. Nothing like what happened to Jerusalem has occurred anywhere else in the world.

verses.kjv: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
verses.decoded: As it is written in the law of Moses, all these disasters have come upon us, yet we have not prayed to the LORD our God to turn away from our sins and understand your truth.

verses.kjv: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
verses.decoded: So the LORD has allowed this disaster to come upon us because he is righteous in all he does, and we have not obeyed him.

verses.kjv: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
verses.decoded: Now, O Lord our God, you who brought your people out of Egypt with great power and made a name for yourself even to this day, we have sinned and done wrong.

verses.kjv: O LORD, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
verses.decoded: Lord, because of your righteousness, please turn away your anger and wrath from Jerusalem, your holy city. Our sins and the sins of our ancestors have caused Jerusalem and your people to be scorned by everyone around us.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
verses.decoded: So now, our God, please listen to my prayer and requests. Let your favor shine on your desolate sanctuary for your own glory.

verses.kjv: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.
verses.decoded: My God, please listen and look at our destruction and the city named after you. We don’t ask because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.

verses.kjv: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
verses.decoded: Lord, please listen, forgive, and act quickly for your own sake, because your city and people bear your name.

verses.kjv: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
verses.decoded: While I was praying, confessing my sins and the sins of Israel, and asking the Lord my God for the restoration of his holy mountain,

verses.kjv: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
verses.decoded: As I was praying, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in an earlier vision, came quickly and touched me around the time of the evening sacrifice.

verses.kjv: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
verses.decoded: He explained things to me and said, 'Daniel, I have come to give you insight and understanding.'

verses.kjv: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
verses.decoded: The message was sent as soon as you began praying, and I have come to explain it because you are highly favored. So pay attention and understand the vision.

verses.kjv: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
verses.decoded: Seventy weeks have been set for your people and your holy city to finish sin, end wrongdoing, atone for guilt, bring in everlasting righteousness, confirm the vision and prophecy, and anoint the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
verses.decoded: Understand this: from the time the order is given to rebuild Jerusalem until the coming of the Messiah, there will be seven weeks plus sixty-two weeks. During this time, the streets and walls will be rebuilt despite difficult times.

verses.kjv: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
verses.decoded: After the sixty-two weeks, the Messiah will be killed, though not for his own wrongdoing. Then the people of a coming ruler will destroy the city and the temple. The destruction will be overwhelming, and desolations will continue until the war ends.

verses.kjv: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
verses.decoded: He will make a strong agreement with many for one week. Halfway through, he will stop the sacrifices and offerings. Because of widespread evil, he will cause the temple to become desolate until the end, and what is decided will be poured out on the desolate one.

verses.kjv: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.decoded: In the third year of King Cyrus of Persia, a revelation was given to Daniel, also known as Belteshazzar. The revelation was true, but the time for it to happen was far off. Daniel understood the message and the vision.

verses.kjv: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
verses.decoded: During that time, I, Daniel, was grieving and fasting for three full weeks.

verses.kjv: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.decoded: I did not eat any tasty food, nor did I eat meat or drink wine, and I did not use any oil on myself until the three weeks were over.

verses.kjv: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
verses.decoded: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing by the great river called Hiddekel (Tigris).

verses.kjv: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.decoded: I looked up and saw a man dressed in linen with a belt made of pure gold from Uphaz around his waist.

verses.kjv: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.decoded: His body shone like a precious stone called beryl; his face flashed like lightning; his eyes burned like fiery lamps; his arms and legs gleamed like polished bronze; and his voice sounded like a loud crowd.

verses.kjv: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.decoded: Only I, Daniel, saw the vision. The men with me did not see it, but they were so terrified that they ran away to hide.

verses.kjv: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.decoded: I was left alone and saw this amazing vision. I lost all my strength; my appearance became weak and unhealthy, and I had no energy left.

verses.kjv: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
verses.decoded: But I heard the sound of his words. When I heard them, I fell into a deep sleep with my face down on the ground.

verses.kjv: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a hand touched me and helped me get up onto my knees and hands.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.decoded: He said to me, 'Daniel, man greatly loved, listen carefully to what I say and stand up, because I have been sent to you.' When he said this, I stood up, shaking.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
verses.decoded: He told me, 'Don't be afraid, Daniel. From the first day you decided to seek understanding and humble yourself before God, your prayers were heard. I have come because of your prayers.'

verses.kjv: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.decoded: But the spiritual ruler of Persia resisted me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief angels, came to help me, and I stayed there with the rulers of Persia.

verses.kjv: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
verses.decoded: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future, because this vision concerns many days yet to come.

verses.kjv: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.decoded: After he said these things to me, I bowed my face to the ground and was unable to speak.

verses.kjv: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.decoded: Then someone who looked like a human touched my lips. I opened my mouth and said to the one standing before me, 'My lord, this vision has overwhelmed me with sorrow, and I have no strength left.'

verses.kjv: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
verses.decoded: How can I, your servant, speak to you, my lord? I have no strength left, and I can barely breathe.

verses.kjv: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
verses.decoded: Then someone who looked like a man touched me again and gave me strength.

verses.kjv: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.decoded: He said, 'You who are highly valued, don’t be afraid. Peace be with you; be strong and courageous.' After he spoke, I felt stronger and said, 'Please, speak, my lord, because you have given me strength.'

verses.kjv: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Do you know why I have come to you? Now I must return to fight against the prince of Persia. After I leave, the prince of Greece will come.'

verses.kjv: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
verses.decoded: But I will show you what is written in the book of truth. No one supports me in this fight except Michael, your protector.

verses.kjv: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.decoded: In the first year of Darius the Mede, I was there to support and strengthen him.

verses.kjv: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
verses.decoded: Now I will reveal the truth: three more kings will rise in Persia, and the fourth will be much richer than all the others. Using his wealth and power, he will provoke conflict against Greece.

verses.kjv: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.decoded: A powerful king will arise who will rule with great authority and act according to his own desires.

verses.kjv: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.decoded: When he rises to power, his kingdom will be broken and divided in all directions. It will not be passed on to his descendants or kept as he ruled it, because his kingdom will be taken away and given to others.

verses.kjv: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.decoded: The king of the south will be powerful, and one of his princes will be even stronger, ruling over him with a great kingdom.

verses.kjv: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
verses.decoded: After many years, they will form an alliance when the king’s daughter from the south marries the king of the north to make a treaty. But she will not keep her power, nor will he remain strong. She and those connected to her will be betrayed and given up.

verses.kjv: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.decoded: But from her family line, someone will rise to power, lead an army, invade the northern king’s stronghold, fight against them, and succeed.

verses.kjv: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
verses.decoded: He will take captives, including their gods, leaders, and valuable silver and gold items, into Egypt. He will rule longer than the king of the north.

verses.kjv: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
verses.decoded: The king of the south will invade the northern king’s territory but will eventually return to his own land.

verses.kjv: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
verses.decoded: His sons will be provoked and gather a large army. One of them will invade, overwhelm the enemy, and then return, preparing again for battle even at his own stronghold.

verses.kjv: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.decoded: The king of the south will become angry and go out to fight the king of the north. He will gather a large army, but that army will be defeated and captured.

verses.kjv: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
verses.decoded: After capturing the army, he will become proud and defeat many thousands, but he will not gain lasting strength from this victory.

verses.kjv: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
verses.decoded: The king of the north will come back with an even larger army than before, arriving after some years with great wealth and power.

verses.kjv: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
verses.decoded: During that time, many will rise up against the king of the south. Even those who have wronged your people will try to support this prophecy, but they will ultimately fail.

verses.kjv: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
verses.decoded: The king of the north will advance, build a siege ramp, and capture the strongest fortified cities. The southern forces, including their best soldiers, will be unable to resist or defend.

verses.kjv: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
verses.decoded: The one who attacks him will act as he wishes, and no one will be able to resist him. He will take control of the beautiful land, which he will destroy by his power.

verses.kjv: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
verses.decoded: He will determine to invade with the full power of his kingdom and honorable allies. He will give him a woman as a wife to corrupt her, but she will not support or help him.

verses.kjv: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
verses.decoded: Afterward, he will turn his attention to distant islands and conquer many. But a leader acting for himself will stop the insults he caused and will redirect the disgrace back onto him without harming himself.

verses.kjv: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.decoded: Then he will turn back to defend his own fortified land, but he will fail and disappear without a trace.

verses.kjv: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.decoded: Then a tax collector will rise to power in the kingdom’s place, but he will be quickly removed—not by war or anger.

verses.kjv: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.decoded: After him, a dishonorable person will appear, someone not given the rightful respect as king. He will take the throne peacefully by using deceit and flattery.

verses.kjv: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.decoded: His forces will overwhelm them like a flood, breaking their resistance—including the leader associated with the covenant.

verses.kjv: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.decoded: After making an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully. He will rise to power and become strong despite having a small group of supporters.

verses.kjv: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
verses.decoded: He will peacefully take control of the richest parts of the province and do things his ancestors never did. He will distribute the loot and wealth among his people and plan attacks against fortified places for a limited time.

verses.kjv: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
verses.decoded: He will gather his strength and courage to fight the king of the south with a large army. The king of the south will respond with an even larger force, but he will be defeated because plans will be made against him.

verses.kjv: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.decoded: Those who share his food and support will betray and destroy him. His army will be overwhelmed, and many soldiers will be killed.

verses.kjv: And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
verses.decoded: Both kings will plan evil and lie together while sharing a meal, but their plans will fail because the end will come at the appointed time.

verses.kjv: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
verses.decoded: Then he will return home with great wealth, but his attitude will be hostile toward the holy covenant. He will perform notable actions and then go back to his land.

verses.kjv: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
verses.decoded: At the set time, he will come back and move southward, but this time it will be different from his previous attempts.

verses.kjv: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.decoded: Ships from Cyprus (Chittim) will oppose him, causing him distress. He will turn back angry against the holy covenant and will make secret agreements with those who abandon it.

verses.kjv: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
verses.decoded: His forces will take control and defile the stronghold sanctuary, stop the regular sacrifices, and set up the disgusting thing that causes desolation.

verses.kjv: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
verses.decoded: He will deceive those who break the covenant through lies and flattery, but those who truly know God will remain strong and act courageously.

verses.kjv: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
verses.decoded: Those with insight will teach many, but they will suffer violence, imprisonment, and plunder for a long time.

verses.kjv: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
verses.decoded: When they are defeated, they will receive some help, but many will join them only with false promises.

verses.kjv: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
verses.decoded: Some of the wise will suffer to test and refine them, purifying them until the end time, because this period is fixed.

verses.kjv: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
verses.decoded: The king will act as he pleases, glorifying himself above all gods, speaking against the true God, and succeeding until God's anger is fulfilled because what is planned will happen.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.decoded: He will not honor his ancestors' God, nor care about women’s desires, nor respect any god, because he will elevate himself above all.

verses.kjv: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
verses.decoded: Instead, in his position, he will honor a god of armies, a god unknown to his ancestors, and will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and valuable gifts.

verses.kjv: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
verses.decoded: He will act this way in fortified places, honoring a foreign god and glorifying it, and he will appoint rulers over many people and divide the land for profit.

verses.kjv: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.decoded: At the end times, the king of the south will attack him, but the king of the north will come against him fiercely with chariots, cavalry, and many ships, invading and overwhelming countries.

verses.kjv: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: He will invade the beautiful land, overthrow many countries, but Edom, Moab, and the leaders of Ammon will escape his control.

verses.kjv: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.decoded: He will extend his power over many countries, and Egypt will not be spared.

verses.kjv: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.decoded: He will control Egypt’s wealth of gold, silver, and valuable goods, and Libyans and Ethiopians will follow him closely.

verses.kjv: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.decoded: News from the east and north will alarm him, so he will respond with furious attacks to destroy many.

verses.kjv: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.decoded: He will set up his royal headquarters between the seas on the beautiful holy mountain, but he will ultimately be destroyed with no one to help him.

verses.kjv: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.decoded: At that time, Michael, the great protector of your people, will arise. There will be a period of unprecedented distress, unlike anything the world has ever seen. But during that time, your people will be saved—everyone whose name is recorded in the book will be rescued.

verses.kjv: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.decoded: Many who have died and are resting in the earth will be resurrected—some to eternal life, and others to eternal disgrace and punishment.

verses.kjv: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: Those who are wise will shine brightly like the sky, and those who lead many to live rightly will shine like the stars forever.

verses.kjv: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.decoded: Daniel, keep these words secret and seal the book until the end times. During that period, people will travel widely and knowledge will greatly increase.

verses.kjv: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.decoded: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing—one on this side of the riverbank and the other on the opposite side.

verses.kjv: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
verses.decoded: One of them asked the man dressed in linen, who was standing above the river, 'How long will it be until these amazing events are completed?'

verses.kjv: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.decoded: I heard the man in linen standing above the river raise both hands to heaven and swear by the eternal God that it will last for a time, two times, and half a time. When he has finished breaking the power of the holy people, everything will be complete.

verses.kjv: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.decoded: I heard this but didn’t understand it, so I asked, 'My Lord, what will be the outcome of all this?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.decoded: He told me, 'Go your way, Daniel. These words are sealed and hidden until the end times.'

verses.kjv: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.decoded: Many will be purified, made clean, and tested. But the wicked will continue doing evil and will not understand; only the wise will grasp what is happening.

verses.kjv: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.decoded: From the moment the daily sacrifice is stopped and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the one who waits and reaches the 1,335th day.

verses.kjv: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
verses.decoded: But you, Daniel, go on your way until the end. You will rest and then rise to receive your inheritance at the end of days.
